tree.heading: National Forest lands
tree.text: The term “National Forest lands” means lands included in the National Forest System (as defined in section 1609(a) of this title).

tree.heading: Recreation Area
tree.text: The term “Recreation Area” means the Spring Mountains National Recreation Area established by this subchapter.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture.

notes.text: Short TitlePub. L. 103–63, § 1, Aug. 4, 1993, 107 Stat. 297, provided that: “This Act [enacting this subchapter] may be cited as the ‘Spring Mountains National Recreation Area Act’.”
